title: Audit #4633: full replay, native contract failures and verifier false positives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This is a negative, exact-head audit of #4633 at `b2998bacd50d57c301fe67c5392054440c42398c` and its nine-file update `b390d64abfcdba1a3816b86fc763cbc95d43c12c`. The submitted numerical replays pass, but the claimed native supplier and outer saving do not follow. GitHub closed #4633 without merging during this audit; this work did not close it.

The current three-dimensional BIT quotient erases 41 rational entrance lines spanning rank eight, fails the retained rank-seven transport pair on all 111 ports, and still passes its verifier after all 2,184 positive MOVE charges are zeroed (reported κ = 0.25) or every frame basis is emptied. The complete updated scan also contradicts the claimed three-dimensional plateau and four-dimensional decline.

The report, source snapshots, independent counterexample verifiers and complete replay evidence are in [research/pr4633-quotient-contract-audit](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/tree/b0a325a3e312b7c5ebceb420de4b8cb13181f43e/research/pr4633-quotient-contract-audit). The proposed central-ledger entry records the negative review and observed unmerged closure separately from acceptance. No selected result or production verifier changes.

## Task and overlap

User-assigned full audited replay, based on `fbc9ea0249746acca4f504d4fda2b84e0e36cf0d`. All 21 changed files and the subsequent nine-file delta are covered. This explicitly changes the `bit-helper-contract` card's scope to an audit.

Overlaps #4604 and [Rohan Arun's concurrent port-contract comment](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4633#issuecomment-6341849407). Added evidence includes rational-field counterexamples, verifier mutations, both-head full scans and exact native complex transport checks. The unchanged complex package from #4629 is included in the reviewed diff.

## Validation

Python 3.12.15; serial replay with explicit timeouts and a sampled 1 GiB process-group RSS limit:

- Both original registered packages and the updated BIT package pass.
- All four artifact rebuilds match committed bytes.
- Full original scans: 255 BIT kernels and 511 complex kernels.
- Full updated submitted domain: 1,940 candidates; 438 of 455 triples accepted with 145 distinct numerical values, not the claimed 445 identical results.
- Original BIT rational-projector control passes.
- All 2,101 distinct complex climb/helper edges lower in both orientations with exact rank and absolute-phase recipe decoding.
- Source-bound independent counterexamples, meaningful mutation controls, committed-byte/source-history preflight, and focused central-ledger consistency checks pass.

Reproduce the short audit with:
```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr4633-quotient-contract-audit
```
Full author replay commands, logs, resource receipts, per-candidate results and limits are retained in `REPLAY.json` and `evidence/`. The first source-control import required the documented retained dependency path; both the failure and successful retry are preserved. No unchanged selected-frontier cold replay, Lean proof, all-history suite or manual hosted workflow was run.

## Credit

DaysSky's source bytes and notices are retained. Credit to DreamingOfClouds/eumemic and the PR589 lineage, PR4470 and its predecessors, Ryanson Jonathan (#4604), and Rohan Arun's concurrent review. Prepared for Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

A revised construction needs native rational frame realizations, a proved per-port controller and rederived output invoice, geometry-authenticated MOVE pricing, and complete strict ordinary-BIT/outer admission. The audit establishes no corrected κ.
